title: STORY-010 Security Audit Logging - demonstrated on the synthetic demo deployment

tiles.label: 1. Every kind of event, newest first; write-once, kept 7 years
2. One person's whole trail: fields changed, never values
3. Every refusal: who, what was tried, 401 or 403
4. Demo site after the deploy: audit log listed as done
5. Demo site: a citizen cannot open the audit log
